archive.catalogue_description: Hello guy’s this is my first map on zm so plz don’t hate on it dance1 This is the fist map by the group 115 mappers. We took a break on junkyard but we will work on it asap. Feature’s… Pack-a-punch All perks (jugg, speed, doubletap, revive, deadshot, stamin-up and mule kick (sorry no phd) Ported weps from MW2 and MW1 List: Ak-47 RPD M40A3 MP5 UZI M14 P90 CoD4 models (cars and heli pretty much) lmao1 Verrukt sprinters (Freaking hard) owned2 NO CONSOLE! Cheating bastards! ballbuster1 Credits.. Custom guns thanks to CFG Factory, Sanya, Koene007 cod4 guns thanks to Rollonmath42 Black ops perks thanks to bamskater33 and OnlineX420 Buyable Ending thanks to Tom_Bmx Verruckt Runners thanks to losangeles26 fixed jugg thanks to quizz custom thompson skin thanks to CFG Factory and a lot to jzob123 for porting the weapons

notes: Replaces common scripts (maps/_callbackglobal.gsc, maps/_gameskill.gsc, maps/_laststand.gsc, maps/_load.gsc, maps/_loadout.gsc); re-verify the generic down/revive/score events on it. Ships 2 executable(s): $PLUGINSDIR/System.dll, $PLUGINSDIR/nsDialogs.dll. NEVER RUN THEM (dev-box.md rule 3). PROVISIONAL: archive/corpus-ignore.json was missing, so corpus boilerplate was not subtracted and this finish may be a shared-script name; scan_maps.py --keep-existing rewrites this manifest.
